note: Dated price records for the API practice-question tier (optivision.easy._probes_api). A price is never a current fact: every cost printed from this file reads [estimate: prices recorded <date>; check the provider's page]. Update a row only from the provider's page and change its recorded date with it. A model without a row is sent only when the user passes a price or accepts that no cost can be printed.

prices.note: USD per million tokens. The long-prompt rates apply to a request whose prompt is over long_prompt_tokens. An image costs ceil(width/28) x ceil(height/28) tokens after it is scaled to fit image_max_edge_px and image_max_tokens (high-resolution tier). chars_per_token is a conservative text divisor, because this model counts about 30% more tokens per text than the model before it.
